_doc: Authored attribution for public-records-portal releases (portal_ingest.py, pdf_table_ingest.py): which Flock org's log a file is, in the registry's flock_names spelling. Precedence: 'files' ('<host>:<request>:<file as saved>') over 'requests' ('<host>:<request>') over the file name ('<dates>-<Org>-[Network-]Audit') over the request's own-search dominant Org Name over 'hosts'. A host entry says whose records portal it is, so it is the fallback for a file that names no org (e.g. 'Manteca_CA_PD_network_Apr_2024.csv'); a city portal can also post another agency's log, which needs a 'files' or 'requests' entry with its own source.
